title: AI Hedge Fund — Multi-Agent Investment Decision System
excerpt: An AI-powered hedge fund employing 18+ specialized analyst agents modeled after legendary investors like Warren Buffett, Ben Graham, and Cathie Wood to collaboratively analyze stocks, manage risk, and produce trading decisions. Built with LangGraph orchestration, FastAPI backend, and React Flow visual workflow editor. Supports single-run analysis and historical backtesting with performance metrics.

title: AI Hedge Fund/agents — Analyst Agent Framework
excerpt: 20 analyst agents implementing diverse investment strategies. Includes 12 LLM-driven persona agents modeled after legendary investors (Warren Buffett, Ben Graham, Charlie Munger, Michael Burry, Peter Lynch, Cathie Wood, etc.) plus 8 quantitative agents for technicals, fundamentals, valuation, sentiment, growth, and risk management. Each agent fetches financial data, applies strategy-specific analysis, and returns bullish/bearish/neutral signals with confidence scores.

title: AI Hedge Fund/backtesting — Historical Backtesting Engine
excerpt: Historical backtesting engine with multi-day simulation loop, portfolio tracking (long/short positions, margin, realized gains), trade execution, performance metrics (Sharpe ratio, Sortino ratio, max drawdown), and SPY benchmark comparison. Key classes: BacktestEngine, Portfolio, TradeExecutor, PerformanceMetricsCalculator, AgentController, BenchmarkCalculator, OutputBuilder.

title: AI Hedge Fund/graph — LangGraph Workflow Orchestration
excerpt: LangGraph-based workflow orchestration using StateGraph with AgentState TypedDict. Supports message accumulation via operator.add, dictionary merging via merge_dicts operator, and configurable analyst node composition. The create_workflow() function in main.py builds the graph connecting selected analyst agents to risk manager and portfolio manager nodes.

title: AI Hedge Fund/llm — Multi-Provider LLM Management
excerpt: Multi-provider LLM model configuration supporting 13+ providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Google, Groq, Ollama, Azure OpenAI, XAI, GigaChat, OpenRouter, Mistral, Meta, Alibaba. LLMModel Pydantic config with display_name, model_name, provider. Factory function get_model() handles provider-specific initialization with API key resolution from state, environment, or parameters.

title: AI Hedge Fund/data — Financial Data Models & Caching
excerpt: Pydantic data models for financial data: Price (OHLCV), FinancialMetrics (40+ fields including P/E, ROE, margins, growth rates), LineItem (generic financial line item), InsiderTrade (transaction details), CompanyNews (sentiment-tagged articles), CompanyFacts. In-memory Cache class with per-type storage, merge/deduplication logic, and composite cache keys.

title: AI Hedge Fund/tools — Financial Data API Client
excerpt: Financial Datasets API client with rate limiting (429 backoff with linear delays: 60s, 90s, 120s), pagination for insider trades and company news, in-memory caching integration, and DataFrame conversion. Core functions: get_prices(), get_financial_metrics(), search_line_items(), get_insider_trades(), get_company_news(), get_market_cap(). Base URL: api.financialdatasets.ai.

title: AI Hedge Fund/cli — Command-Line Interface
excerpt: Command-line interface with CLIInputs dataclass, argument parsing via argparse, interactive analyst selection using questionary prompts, model picking with Ollama support, date resolution with configurable lookback. Supports both single-run hedge fund analysis and backtesting modes with --tickers, --start-date, --end-date, --initial-capital, --margin-requirement flags.

title: AI Hedge Fund/utils — Shared Utilities & Infrastructure
excerpt: Shared utilities including call_llm() with retries and Pydantic parsing, ANALYST_CONFIG registry mapping 20 analyst keys to functions, AgentProgress with Rich live table display, output formatting with colorama and tabulate, Ollama model management (install/start/download/delete), Docker utilities, API key extraction from state, and graph visualization with Mermaid PNG export.

title: AI Hedge Fund/app_backend — FastAPI Web Backend
excerpt: FastAPI REST API with SSE streaming for real-time agent progress. Routes: POST /hedge-fund/run (SSE execution), POST /hedge-fund/backtest, flows CRUD, API key management, language model listing. Services: graph construction from React Flow nodes/edges, backtest service, portfolio management. Database: SQLAlchemy models for HedgeFundFlow, FlowRun, FlowRunCycle, ApiKey with Alembic migrations.

title: AI Hedge Fund/app_frontend — React Visual Workflow Editor
excerpt: React 18 + TypeScript visual workflow editor using React Flow (@xyflow/react). Features drag-and-drop agent nodes, real-time SSE execution with progress updates, per-agent model selection, backtest visualization, undo/redo history, and flow persistence. Key contexts: FlowContext, NodeContext, LayoutContext, TabsContext. Nodes: AgentNode, StockAnalyzerNode, PortfolioManagerNode, PortfolioStartNode.
